CUSTOM_SECTIONS.ConfigureHint: Items with custom sections will automatically appear in their respective categories in the appropriate tab (Inventory, Features, or Spells) based on the item type. To assign a section to an item, edit the item and enter a section name in the Details tab.

EnableCustomSections.Name: Enable Custom Item Sections
EnableCustomSections.Hint: Allow items to be organized into custom sections in character sheets across different tabs

EnableCellInventory.Name: Cell Inventory Mode (10x10)
EnableCellInventory.Hint: Replace the inventory list with a 10x10 grid of 100x100 cells. Items can be dragged between cells.

EnableGridInventory.Name: Grid Inventory View (icons only)
EnableGridInventory.Hint: Display inventory items as square icon tiles (names/details hidden; shown in tooltip). Applies to both default and custom sections.

CellInventory.SizeHint: How many cells the item occupies horizontally and vertically. Default is 1x1.
CellInventory.DoesNotFit: This item does not fit in the selected cells.

CUSTOM_SECTIONS.NonStackableHint: If enabled, this item will not merge into a stack even when it is outside the preset non-stackable categories.
CUSTOM_SECTIONS.ContentWeightReductionHint: Items inside this container count with reduced weight by the specified percentage (0–100%). Works only when the container is equipped.
CUSTOM_SECTIONS.CategoryFilterHint: Category is taken from the item's 'Section' field. In 'Only listed' mode the container accepts only items with listed categories; in 'All except listed' — any except listed.
CUSTOM_SECTIONS.CategoryReject: This item is not allowed by the container's category rules.
CUSTOM_SECTIONS.CapacityExceeded: Not enough remaining capacity in the container.
